title: Compromised agency credential with authorised-operator alternative
description: Primary route: compromised agency-password reference, a distinct password-authenticated identity context, a shared agency workstation, the scheduling application and limited synthetic agency data. Separate residual precondition: an already attacker-controlled authorised agency operator has completed required authentication and holds only necessary delegated permissions. MFA can remove the primary route while the residual route retains the same designed peak risk; these are design intentions, not observed results.
recommendation: Use MFA for agency password access and review third-party assurance, delegated permissions and monitoring; retain the explicitly assumed authorised-operator residual route in the explanation.
